items.exampleEn: The dormitory doors are locked at midnight, so don't come back late.
items.exampleZh: 宿舍大門半夜十二點就會上鎖，所以別太晚回來。

items.exampleEn: In history class, we compared the polities of ancient Greek cities.
items.exampleZh: 歷史課上，我們比較了古希臘城邦的政體。

items.exampleEn: Swimming across the strait takes about ten hours.
items.exampleZh: 游泳橫渡那道海峽大約要十小時。

items.exampleEn: When the river rose, families in the lowlands moved to higher ground.
items.exampleZh: 河水上漲時，住在低地的家庭搬到地勢較高的地方。

items.exampleEn: The word commonwealth once meant a group working for the good of everyone.
items.exampleZh: commonwealth 這個字以前指為所有人福祉而努力的群體。

items.exampleEn: The road turns northward after the bridge.
items.exampleZh: 過了橋之後，道路轉向北方。

items.exampleEn: The storm is moving eastward and should reach the coast tonight.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨正往東移動，今晚應該會到達海岸。

items.exampleEn: The barbershop has a red, white and blue sign outside.
items.exampleZh: 那家理髮店外面有一個紅白藍相間的招牌。

items.sentenceEn: The ship sailed slowly through the narrow strait.
items.sentenceZh: 那艘船緩緩駛過狹窄的海峽。

items.audioEn: The barbershop on the corner is closed on Mondays, so let's go on Tuesday instead.
items.audioZh: 轉角的理髮店星期一公休，我們改星期二去吧。
items.questionZh: 說話者建議哪天去理髮店？

items.sentenceEn: After lunch, we drove northward along the coast.
items.sentenceZh: 午餐後，我們沿著海岸往北開。

items.sentenceEn: Our new dormitory has a kitchen on every floor.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的新宿舍每層樓都有廚房。

items.stemEn: Most of the country's farms are in the flat ____ in the south.
items.stemZh: 這個國家大部分的農場都在南部平坦的低地。

items.stemEn: The sun rises in the morning, so if you walk toward it, you are walking ____.
items.stemZh: 早上太陽升起時，朝著太陽走，就是在往東走。

items.passageEn: My grandfather loves history, and every Saturday he tells stories at the old barbershop, a well-known place in our town, where he gets his hair cut. Last week, he talked about people who walked across a land bridge where the Bering Strait is today. Over thousands of years, they moved eastward and then southward, settling in lowlands with rivers and good soil. He explained that early groups slowly built their own polity, with leaders and rules. Some later joined together into a kind of commonwealth to trade and help each other. The barber laughed and said my grandfather should become a lecturer at the university instead.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺很喜歡歷史，每個星期六都會在他剪頭髮的那家老理髮店講故事，那家店在我們鎮上很有名。上週，他講到古人走過一座陸橋，那裡就是今天的白令海峽。幾千年來，他們先往東、再往南遷移，在有河流和肥沃土壤的低地定居。他解釋說，早期的群體慢慢建立起自己的政體，有領袖也有規矩。後來有些群體結合成一種共同體，互相貿易、彼此幫忙。理髮師笑著說，我爺爺應該去大學當講師才對。

questions.questionZh: 古人最後在什麼地方定居？
options: 冰天雪地、終年寒冷的北方
有河流和好土壤的低地

questions.questionZh: 理髮師聽完後說了什麼？
options: 要爺爺快一點把頭髮剪完
爺爺應該去大學當講師

items.promptZh: 這群鳥每年秋天都會往南飛，春天再往北飛回來。
referenceEn: These birds fly south every autumn and fly northward again in spring.
Every autumn the birds go south, and in spring they fly back northward.
rubricZh: 要用 northward 表示「向北」（例如 fly northward）

items.promptZh: 那家理髮店的老闆已經在這裡幫人剪了四十年的頭髮。
referenceEn: The owner of that barbershop has been cutting hair here for forty years.
The man who owns that barbershop has cut hair here for forty years.
rubricZh: barbershop 指理髮店（例如 the owner of that barbershop 等）
「已經…四十年」用現在完成式或現在完成進行式（例如 has cut、has been cutting 等）
